segments.name: Building Products Distribution
segments.description: Distributes roofing, waterproofing and complementary building products to residential and non-residential customers across North America.
segments.evidence: QXO Building Products offers an extensive range of high-quality professional grade exterior products and serves over 110,000 residential and non-residential customers.

revenueModel.text: The company sells building products to contractors and customers, earning revenue from product sales through its distribution network.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's revenues for its single operating segment are primarily derived from the sale of residential and non-residential roofing products, as well as complementary products, such as siding and waterproofing.
